en: A black-and-white vintage image showing a peaceful street scene with old wooden houses on the left and a cobbled street lined with trees leading down toward a view of smaller distant homes and countryside. There are three people, dressed in early 20th-century fashion, standing on the left sidewalk. The image is bordered in a way typical for vintage postcards and has decorative script text at the bottom.
